questions.question: She said she would have finished the project earlier if she had more time. What is the correct way to report this as direct speech?
options: ‘I would have finished the project earlier if I had more time.’
‘I finished the project earlier if I had more time.’
‘She finished the project earlier if she had more time.’
‘She would have finished the project earlier, but she didn’t have enough time.’
